title: Austin Leaders Tackle Open Government
summary:
*   City leaders held a special work session to discuss municipal transparency.
*   The meeting's sole focus was on reviewing and potentially acting on open government practices and policies.
*   Discussions centered on enhancing the city's approach to public information and accountability.
